Name: (CP)Arknights.Longbao
Author: lingfen
Description:
一些来自游戏《明日方舟》的龙泡泡家具。

本来这个模组应该在大年初一发，因为各种原因耽误了
此次模组包含的是32*32大小的龙泡泡，后续会出16*16尺寸的龙泡泡以及相关食物！谢谢大家喜欢！

目前官方已出的龙泡泡有7个，剩下的形象都是我根据已公布的立绘画的龙泡泡，所以多出来的特征要多一点。
方的龙泡泡形象来自：
[u][b]小红书：神秘吃饭人 b站：米牢黍没有米（同一个老师）
（借鉴方的形象已获得老师授权！不相信可以问我要授权截图！）[/b][/u]



I used a translator for this part.

Some Longbao furniture from the game Arknights.

This mod includes 32×32 Longbao decorations. 16×16 Longbao and related food items will be released in the future! Thank you all for your support!

There are currently 7 officially released Longbao designs. All the remaining ones are my original interpretations drawn based on the published character illustrations, which is why they feature more distinctive details.
[u][b]
The fang Longbao design is adapted from:
小红书：神秘吃饭人 b站：米牢黍没有米（same）[/b][/u]
